name: actual_memory_pressure_is_contained_and_recoverable

test_list.description: Observe cgroup memory and swap bounds before touching a bounded allocator, require a real oom_kill counter increment, subsequent command recovery, and authoritative owned-container absence after Reaper cleanup.

inputs.name: private_gateway
inputs.description: Explicitly supplied isolated gateway state, mTLS directory and immutable image digest.

output_description: Real bounded cgroup OOM evidence and zero retained ownership, or failure preserving an unresolved cleanup journal.
